text: Milverton Boulevard is a residential street with two-way traffic. I have heard from residents of Milverton Boulevard about serious traffic safety concerns that threaten pedestrian safety and they contacted me to request an additional speed hump be installed on Milverton Boulevard between Coxwell Avenue and Monarch Park Avenue. In order to improve resident and pedestrian safety, the installation of an additional speed hump is being requested.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Requested Transportation Services to study the feasibility of installing an additional speed hump between on Milverton Boulevard between Coxwell Avenue and Monarch Park Avenue and to report back to Toronto and East York Community Council at the November 24, 2021 meeting.
